name: eco-support
description: EcoSupport - Autonomous niche ecosystem radar and support engine. Scan ecosystems, triage issues, generate MCP bridges, audit security.
author: thanhnt-sm

workflows.name: Scan Niche Ecosystem
workflows.description: Discover critical infrastructure in niche software ecosystems
steps: Run 'eco-support scan --category C-FFI --limit 20' to find C FFI libraries
Review ECI scores and tier classifications (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW)
Use '--detailed' for maintainer and dependency info

workflows.name: Automated Issue Triage
workflows.description: Deep analysis of GitHub issues with severity, labels, and patch plans
steps: Review severity, suggested labels, and assignees

workflows.name: Generate MCP Server
workflows.description: Create a complete FastMCP server from API specifications
steps: Run 'eco-support synthesize-mcp --package my-api --api "REST API with users, posts" --output ./mcp-server'
Review generated tools, resources, and prompts

workflows.name: Security Audit MCP Server
workflows.description: Comprehensive vulnerability scanning of MCP server source code
steps: Apply recommended fixes for injection, auth, data exposure risks

workflows.name: Run MCP Server
workflows.description: Start EcoSupport MCP server for agent integration

install.source: git clone https://github.com/thanhnt-sm/eco_support_net_oracle.git && pnpm install && pnpm run build
